description: Baseline for the official FHIR example corpus sweep in crates/fhir-validator/tests/spec_examples.rs. Every entry is a published spec example that the structural validator reports issues on -- i.e. a suspected false positive in the engine, not a defect in the example. Entries may only be removed (by fixing the engine), never added without review. Regenerate with the copy of this file the test writes to target/spec-examples/<version>.actual.json.
